{{Quote|There's just enough time to present my plan to the Merchant Council meeting. Let's go!|[[Mungo Baobab]]|<ref name="Escape from the Monster Ship: A Droid Adventure">''[[Escape from the Monster Ship: A Droid Adventure]]''</ref>}}
The '''Baobab Merchant Council''' was an organization on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manda/Legends|Manda]]. They held meetings in the Merchant Council chamber, during which they assigned missions to junior members. [[Mungo Baobab's father]] was a member of the council. In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], the council ordered [[Mungo Baobab]] to undertake a mission to the planet [[Hrill]]. Baobab ignored the order and instead traveled to the [[Roon system/Legends|Roon system]] to find the fabled [[Roonstone]]s. He brought the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] with him.
